title: Onimai + Komi Music
description: A resource pack that changes the game's music to the Onimai and Komi OST. I tried to make the songs fit whatever biome you're in.
body: This resource pack changes the game's music to the OST of Onimai and Komi Cant Communicate. I tried to make the tracks fit whatever biome you're in (see the difference between the Nether and Overworld). this is just something i made for myself, so i thought id just share it for others because why not.
